== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Lightsaber Deficiency (Japanese)|Lightsaber Deficiency]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940016/JLudwUus8UmlpUHhs7Ix-g.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099791.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>eeb5f414b53b94c38e48d6f24fe40e81dba9f1d521c01661a779af309d9367be</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
